title: LIN Receive
text: Capture pulse width in normal or high resolution modes for F2803x and F2806x processors, 6 outputs, {HRCAP module} sets Select HRCAP module; {HRCAP mode}, {HRCAP clock}, {Enable rising edge interrupt} enables interrupt when rising edge, {Enable falling edge interrupt} enables interrupt when falling edge, {Enable counter overflow interrupt} enables interrupt when counter overflow, {Output type} selects output data type, {Enable counter overflow output} selects to capture HCCOUNTER overflows, {HRCAP output} and {Sample time} sets the frequency at which block reads data. Values come from the instance.

params.name: HRCAP module
params.values: Select HRCAP module HRCAP1 (default) | HRCAP2 | HRCAP3 | HRCAP4

params.name: HRCAP mode
params.values: Select HRCAP mode Normal (default) | High resolution

params.name: HRCAP clock
params.values: Select HRCAP clock SYSCLKOUT (default) | PLL clock

params.name: Enable rising edge interrupt
params.values: Enable interrupt when rising edge is detected on (default) | off

params.name: Enable falling edge interrupt
params.values: Enable interrupt when falling edge is detected on (default) | off

params.name: Enable counter overflow interrupt
params.values: Enable interrupt when counter overflow is detected off (default) | on

params.name: Output type
params.values: Select output data type HRCAPCLK cycles (default) | Microseconds | uint32 | fixdt(0,16,16)

params.name: Enable counter overflow output
params.values: Select to capture HCCOUNTER overflows off (default) | on

params.name: HRCAP output
params.values: High resolution HRCAP output Period only (default) | ON time only | Off time only | On and Off time | All above(Period, On time, Off time )

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Frequency at which block reads data from HRCAP 0.1 (default)
